verseText: ...that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth...
meaning: One day, every human being who has ever lived will bow down before king King Jesus.

recall.question: At the name of Jesus, who will bow?

meaning.question: Who are the people “under the earth?”

application.prompt: One day everyone who has ever lived will bow before Jesus. It doesn't matter whether they followed him during this life or not: one day, everyone will realize that Jesus really was the Son of God. But we shouldn't wait until He comes back to serve Him; we should believe in him today!
